cohort: The study included 9200 neonates born preterm (GA <37 weeks) in Slovenia between 2013 and 2018, with 6252 following spontaneous birth and 2948 following medically indicated birth.
finding: Medically indicated preterm births at less than 32 weeks gestational age were associated with significantly increased neonatal mortality but not neonatal morbidity.
gest_age: 22 0/7 to 36 6/7 weeks (all preterm births) and 22 0/7 to 31 6/7 weeks (extremely to very preterm births)
